QuestInfo.name: The Man Called Arsen
QuestInfo.0: As #p2400005# took #p2450000#'s hand, he made a realization: #p2450000# was NOT a Goddess Teardrop! With nowhere left to turn, and no lead on the real Goddess Teardrop, they turned to #b#p2450001##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2450001# steered them toward #b#p2450006##k, who was the first person to see #p2450000# enter town. He might have some clues...
QuestInfo.2: They visited #p2450006#. Hopefully the old man would know something about #p2450000#.

0.0: Thanks for stopping the explosion... Even though my way totally would have worked. Edelstein should be safe for now, but you two have looked better.
0.1: I can't say I know much about Arsen though. He just showed up one day, and kidnapped Gabrielle. I don't even know what he was after. And, frankly, I don't care. Good riddance.
0.2: #bArsen was an outsider#k. And when you have my job, you know that usually means trouble. Nobody here every tried to blow up our power plant, know what I mean?
0.3: If you're looking to learn more about this Arsen character, talk with #bSurl#k. The files at the precinct said he was the first one to see Arsen.

yes.0: The townsmen may not know it, but you two are heroes. Thanks.

1.0: Don't even say nothing, blondies. You're here because the kidnapper was that blue-haired fella, aren't you?! I KNEW IT! I shoulda kicked his rear right outta town the moment I saw him.

npc.0: If you're looking to learn more about this Arsen character, talk with #bSurl#k. The files at the precinct said he was the first one to see Arsen.
